title: DocTrellis workspace configuration
description: Configures the local preview process launched by the DocTrellis VS Code extension.

command.description: Executable to spawn directly. This is not interpreted as a shell string.

args.description: Arguments passed directly to the executable.

workingDirectory.description: Directory relative to the workspace folder. It must remain inside that folder.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL polled until a 2xx or 3xx response is available.

startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the preview URL.
